headline: Revenue up year over year but margins compress
summary_short: Revenue was $3.71B (+4.6% y/y, -12.2% q/q) while diluted EPS fell to $0.24 from $0.44 both q/q and y/y.
summary_long: Revenue was $3.71B, up 4.6% y/y but down 12.2% q/q. Gross margin was roughly flat q/q (76.4% vs 76.5%) and up 140bp y/y from 74.96%, while operating margin fell to 6.7%, down from 9.5% q/q and 8.6% y/y. Diluted EPS dropped to $0.24 from $0.44 both q/q and y/y. Cash rose to $3.13B, up 1.4% q/q and 18.8% y/y.
